title: Global Market: Data centre boom fuels demand for power, cooling equipment suppliers
summary: The global AI data centre boom is creating fresh opportunities for power and cooling equipment suppliers as developers race to overcome infrastructure bottlenecks. Rising demand for transformers, efficient power systems and liquid cooling is benefiting companies across Asia, although high valuations, supply constraints, competition and deployment delays remain key risks for investors.

title: India's soyoil imports hit record high in August and palm six-month peak, dealers say
summary: Indian refiners sharply increased edible oil imports in August to build stocks ahead of the festive season. Palm oil imports rose 7% to 780,000 tonnes, while soyoil imports jumped 21% to a record 601,000 tonnes.

title: Warren Buffett once called bonds a terrible investment but later massively invested in them. Here's why
summary: Warren Buffett has long warned against long-term bonds, calling them a poor investment for investors with extended horizons. Yet Berkshire Hathaway has amassed a huge short-term Treasury position, highlighting the distinction between long-duration bonds and cash-like instruments. As global yields surge, Buffett’s bond strategy offers a timely lesson for investors.
